records.name: BL_Add_MS_4136_032
records.info: (Satoshi Tomokiyo, 17 September 2023) This is an extract of ciphered segments from a partially enciphered letter. The full letter not found in Patrick Forbes (1740), A Full View Of The Public Transactions In the Riegn of Q. Elisabeth ( Google ) around p.156. What I call "Throckmorton's Cipher 1" is used. The ciphertext in the margin (about half of the sheet) is unidentified.

records.name: BL_Add_MS_4136_033
records.info: (Satoshi Tomokiyo, 16 September 2023) This is an extract of ciphered segments from a partially enciphered letter. The full letter deciphered is printed in Patrick Forbes (1740), A Full View Of The Public Transactions In the Riegn of Q. Elisabeth ( Google ) p.195 The line by "Mr John Wod" is in a different cipher, not deciphered.
